mainEntity.name: How can I make an AI newsletter trustworthy when AI tools change so quickly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Create a source policy before publishing the first issue. Decide which sources are acceptable, how recent information must be, how claims are checked, and how corrections are handled. For AI-tool comparisons, record product name, version or plan, observed capability, date checked, and any limitation that could affect a reader’s decision. Run My AI Biz’s educational content emphasizes sourced comparisons and practical explanations, making documentation especially important. Keep research notes with each draft and separate verified facts from recommendations or experiments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use a documented source policy, date-check tool claims, record plans and limitations, and distinguish verified facts from experiments or recommendations. Keep research notes with every draft and publish corrections when information changes.
